sources.title: Pinehook Harbor Operations Sheet
sources.content:
PINEHOOK HARBOR OPERATIONS SHEET
The public ferry departs from Pier 3.
The departure signal is three short bell tones.
Each ferry crossing may carry up to 42 bicycles.
The reserve fuel tank holds 180 liters.
Harbor radio coordination uses channel 14.

sources.title: North Slope Orchard Field Notes
sources.content:
NORTH SLOPE ORCHARD FIELD NOTES
The test plot grows the Ambercrest apple cultivar.
The orchard test plot contains 18 numbered rows.
The drip irrigation timer runs on Mondays at 06:20.
Harvest crates are held at 4 degrees Celsius.
Mason bees are used to pollinate the test plot.

sources.title: Glasshouse Museum Visitor and Archive Schedule
sources.content:
GLASSHOUSE MUSEUM VISITOR AND ARCHIVE SCHEDULE
The museum is open Tuesday through Saturday from 10:00 to 16:00.
The observatory gallery is closed on Wednesdays.
The daily admission desk stops issuing tickets after 80 visitors.
The museum's first catalog digitization batch was completed in 1963.
The archive atrium is maintained at 47 percent relative humidity.

sources.title: Reef Point Weather Station Field Card
sources.content:
REEF POINT WEATHER STATION FIELD CARD
The coastal weather station is located at Reef Point.
The station's anemometer is mounted 12 meters above ground.
The fog warning threshold is visibility below 1.2 kilometers.
The tidal gauge reference reading is 2.4 meters.
The local high-wind alert begins at 35 knots.

retrieval_only.expected_chunk_source_ids: The source IDs listed on each question are gold relevant source IDs.
retrieval_only.source_identity: Map returned Document metadata file_path or file_name to this fixture's stable source_id; do not use model-generated citations for retrieval metrics.
retrieval_only.target_reference: At least 19 of 20 questions should retrieve a gold source in the first 3 results; report this as a count without tuning the fixture after observing results.

generated_answer.atomic_fact_correct: A question passes only when the answer states all expected fact content accurately; paraphrase is allowed if the value and relation remain unchanged.
generated_answer.citation_valid: The answer must include at least one source citation supporting its expected facts. Every citation must resolve to a source_id actually returned for that question, and the cited source must be in expected_source_ids. An answer with no citation fails.
generated_answer.unsupported_claims: Any factual assertion absent from the retrieved excerpts is an unsupported claim and fails the question.
generated_answer.quotation_integrity: Quoted text must occur verbatim in a retrieved excerpt; otherwise fail the question.
generated_answer.question_pass: atomic_fact_correct AND citation_valid AND no unsupported claims AND quotation_integrity.
generated_answer.target_reference: At least 19 of 20 fixed questions pass. This is fixture-set characterization, not a general factuality claim.

scoring.recording: Freeze model, prompt, tool configuration, retrieved source IDs, outputs, and scoring version before each comparison; retain failures and missing outputs in the denominator.
